description: Camunda 7.24.0 before 7.24.14 and 7.23.0 before 7.23.17 contains an XML External Entity (XXE) injection vulnerability in the camunda-external-task-client's DomXmlDataFormat.defaultDocumentBuilderFactory(), which fails to disable external entity resolution when parsing object variables serialized with application/xml. An attacker able to write a process variable can trigger arbitrary file read and out-of-band outbound HTTP requests from every worker JVM that deserializes the variable, enabling exfiltration of credentials, service-account tokens, and private key material from network segments deeper than the engine itself.
